headword: {防犯登録|ぼうはんとうろく}

definitions.explanation: A legally required registration system for bicycles in Japan. A numbered sticker is attached to the bicycle frame, linking it to the owner's personal information in a police database. Helps identify stolen bicycles and verify ownership.

examples.japanese: {自転車|じてんしゃ}の{防犯登録|ぼうはんとうろく}は{義務|ぎむ}です。
{新|あたら}しい{自転車|じてんしゃ}を{買|か}ったら{防犯登録|ぼうはんとうろく}をしてください。
examples.english: When you buy a new bicycle, please do the anti-theft registration.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}に{自転車|じてんしゃ}を{止|と}められて{防犯登録|ぼうはんとうろく}の{番号|ばんごう}を{確認|かくにん}された。
examples.english: I was stopped by the police and they checked my bicycle registration number.

notes:
CULTURE:
Mandatory since 1994 under Japanese law. The registration costs around 500-600 yen and is valid for 7-10 years depending on the prefecture. Police frequently check registration stickers during routine stops, especially at night. When selling or giving away a bicycle, the registration should be transferred. An unregistered bicycle can be treated as suspicious.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防犯登録|ぼうはんとうろく}をする (to register a bicycle)
- {防犯登録|ぼうはんとうろく}シール (registration sticker)
- {防犯登録|ぼうはんとうろく}{番号|ばんごう} (registration number)
- {防犯登録|ぼうはんとうろく}を{抹消|まっしょう}する (to cancel a registration)
